chunks: He said: Abu Ghalib Ahmad ibn Muhammad reported to me from Abu Tahir Muhammad ibn Sulaiman al-Zurari, who reported from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim, who reported from Kharijah ibn Mus'ab, from Muhammad ibn Abu Umair al-Abdi, who said: Amirul Mu'mineen Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, said:

"Allah did not take a covenant from the people of ignorance for seeking the exposition of knowledge, until He took a covenant from the people of knowledge to expound knowledge to the ignorant, because knowledge was before ignorance."

key_terms.أهل العلم: The people of knowledge; the scholars
key_terms.ميثاق: Covenant; a solemn promise from Allah

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali say about the duty of scholars to teach?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) teaches that Allah obligated the scholars to disseminate knowledge to the ignorant before He obligated the ignorant to seek knowledge, because knowledge was ontologically prior to ignorance. This establishes the primacy of the duty of scholars to teach.
